requirements.text: Bidder should be a company registered under Indian Companies Act, a partnership firm, an LLP or a registered proprietorship firm
Bidder should comply with Sub rule 4 under rule 13 of RTPP 2013 (Land Border Policy)
Annual Average Turnover from IT/ITeS for 2018-19 to 2022-23 should be at least INR 500.00 Crores
Net worth of the bidder as on 31-03-2023 should be Positive
Implemented one IT project similar to ICTMS with value not below INR 100.00 Crore, or two projects not below INR 75.00 Crore each, between 01-Apr-2014 and 30-Apr-2023
Bidder should have valid CMMI level 5 certificate as on last date of bid submission
At least 1,000+ resources in software development profile on full-time payroll
Bidder should have registered GST and Income Tax PAN numbers
Consortium firm should be an ORACLE OEM Partner
Bidder should not be insolvent, bankrupt, convicted or debarred, and should have no conflict of interest
Consortium allowed with only two members: a lead bidder and an ORACLE OEM consortium partner
Period of contract shall be 5 years (20 quarters), with a Design, Develop and Implementation period of 1.5 years (6 quarters)
Performance security shall be 5% of the amount of supply order
Maximum total penalty in any quarter shall not be more than 10% of the total amount due for the quarter
